content.short: GOAT Tribe is a premier Cardano PFP collection featuring 10,000 unique characters and a deep metaverse lore.
content.description: GOAT Tribe is one of the most recognized PFP (Profile Picture) projects in the Cardano ecosystem, consisting of 10,000 unique illustrated characters. Set in a post-apocalyptic world of goat-human hybrids, the project features a rich narrative and an expanding ecosystem that includes sub-collections like Baby GOATS and DNA Kits. Each NFT is composed of hundreds of hand-drawn traits, ensuring high rarity and collector value. With a highly active community and a focus on long-term metaverse utility, GOAT Tribe continues to be a landmark creative initiative within the Cardano blockchain.
